Evaluation Criteria: Verify Work Order #, Job #, City, Designer, and Date are populated on all sheets.
Remediation Guidance: Populate all missing title block fields before submittal.

Evaluation Criteria: Verify California Professional Engineer (P.E.) seal/signature is present where required. Blank box is automatic rejection.
Remediation Guidance: MANDATORY: Submit package to licensed P.E. for digital wet-stamp and seal.

Evaluation Criteria: Confirm official RECORD DRAWING / AS-BUILT stamp is affixed with Foreman signature and date.
Remediation Guidance: Apply official red As-Built stamp, obtain field signature, and record completion date.

Evaluation Criteria: Verify all sheets listed in cover index exist with matching revision numbers.
Remediation Guidance: Reconcile package sheets against cover index; re-insert missing sheets.

Evaluation Criteria: Verify all field changes are drawn in clean red markings with legible callouts.
Remediation Guidance: Redraw field revisions in clean red markings and re-scan at 300+ DPI.

Evaluation Criteria: Confirm plan view drawings display a clear North arrow and graphic scale bar.
Remediation Guidance: Add standard North arrow indicator and graphic bar scale to upper right quadrant.

Evaluation Criteria: Verify minimum trench cover complies with CPUC GO 128 (min 36 in secondary, 42 in primary).
Remediation Guidance: Document measured trench depth on profile sheets or attach approved variance.

Evaluation Criteria: Compare sum of plan conduit footage against billed linear footage in BOM tally sheet (max variance ±2%).
Remediation Guidance: Reconcile plan conduit footage with final BOM tally sheet before submittal.

Evaluation Criteria: Check pole height, class, and framing assemblies against utility engineering standards.
Remediation Guidance: Update pole detail callouts to reflect true as-constructed framing configuration.

Evaluation Criteria: Verify active USA 811 locate ticket number and expiration date are recorded.
Remediation Guidance: Record valid USA 811 ticket number, date, and locate clearance notes on general note sheet.

Evaluation Criteria: Verify major equipment kVA rating, serial numbers, and mounting match approved design.
Remediation Guidance: Update equipment schedules with exact nameplate kVA rating and manufacturer serial #.

Evaluation Criteria: Verify vertical clearance between power conductors and telecom meets CPUC GO 95 (min 40 inches).
Remediation Guidance: Verify field attachment heights on elevation detail sheet and confirm 40 in separation.

Evaluation Criteria: Confirm newly set poles, vaults, and tie-in points include GPS coordinates or surveyor benchmarks.
Remediation Guidance: Add GIS survey coordinates or reference stationing offsets for newly installed facilities.

Evaluation Criteria: Verify hardware items shown on print correspond with material return/reconciliation sheet.
Remediation Guidance: True-up installed hardware counts against warehouse requisitions and log unused material.

Evaluation Criteria: Verify environmental protection conditions and municipal encroachment permit numbers are noted.
Remediation Guidance: Include municipal permit number and certified compliance statement for environmental conditions.

Evaluation Criteria: Verify included field photos cross-reference specific drawing sheets, pole numbers, or stationing.
Remediation Guidance: Annotate each field photo with date taken, view orientation, and asset ID.

Evaluation Criteria: Confirm newly installed circuit work clearly designates source facility without ambiguous gaps.
Remediation Guidance: Clearly label circuit tie-in boundary, existing device identifier, and phase orientation.
